explore.title: Explore
explore.emptyBody: Check the spelling or widen the filters. You can also request this document.
explore.requested: Request sent. Thank you, we’re on it.

detail.notice: Review checks the document’s details, not whether the answers are right. Always compare with your course.

course.emptyBody: No document of this type for this course.

saved.emptyBody: Tap the bookmark on a document to find it here.
saved.guestBody: Sign in to save papers and find them again here.
saved.phoneEmptyBody: Download a paper to read it without a connection.

download.openError: No app on this phone can open PDF files.
download.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from this phone. You can download it again later.

download.unavailable: This file isn’t available for download right now.
download.corrupt: The file arrived damaged and was discarded. Please try again.
download.firstDone: Your first document is on your phone.
download.offlineNotice: You’re offline. Showing the copy on your phone.

reader.missingTitle: This document isn’t on your phone
reader.missingBody: Download it again from its page to read it.
reader.errorMissing: The file is missing from this phone. Download it again.
reader.errorInvalid: This file can’t be read. Try downloading it again.
reader.errorProtected: This PDF is protected and can’t be opened here. Try another app.
reader.errorMemory: This file is too heavy for this phone to display. Try another app.

report.sent: Thank you. A moderator will review this.
report.alreadySent: You already reported this for that reason.
report.error: Couldn’t send your report. Please try again.

contribute.title: Contribute
contribute.intro: Share a paper, a correction or course material. A moderator checks it before it appears.
contribute.guestBody: You need an account to send documents.
contribute.courseNone: No course found. Check the spelling or try the course code.
contribute.sourceNoteOptional: Optional. Say who or where it comes from.
contribute.sourceNoteRequired: Required. Say who or where it comes from.
contribute.titleHelper: Built from your choices. You can edit it.
contribute.rights: I confirm that I have the right to share this document, or that I share it with its owner’s permission. I understand it may be removed if a rights holder asks.
contribute.sent: Thank you! Your document is waiting for review.

errors.fileSize: This file is larger than 25 MB.
errors.sourceNote: Tell us where it comes from.
errors.title: The title needs 3 to 200 characters.
errors.rights: You need to confirm this to send the document.

contribute.errorFile: This file can’t be read as a PDF.
contribute.errorUpload: The upload failed. Check your connection and try again.
contribute.errorSave: Couldn’t save your submission. Check the details and try again.
contribute.errorFinalize: Your document was sent but needs a moderator’s attention. Please tell us if it doesn’t appear.

suggest.link: Can’t find your course? Suggest it

suggest.body: A moderator will add it to the catalogue. Come back to send your document once it appears.
suggest.name: Course name
suggest.sent: Thank you! A moderator will review your suggestion.
suggest.error: Couldn’t send your suggestion. Please try again.
suggest.errorName: Enter the course name (at least 3 letters).

contributions.emptyBody: Documents you contribute appear here with their status.

moderation.fileError: Couldn’t open the file for review.
moderation.published: Published. It’s now visible to students.
moderation.rejected: Rejected. The contributor will see your reason.
moderation.error: Couldn’t update this document. Please try again.
moderation.errorInvalid: That isn’t possible right now. The document may have changed: go back and refresh.

publishDialog.title: Publish this document?
publishDialog.body: “{{title}}” becomes visible to every student. You can restrict or remove it later, but you can’t edit it.

reasonSheet.rejectBody: The contributor will see your reason. Be clear and kind.
